_comment: The Archivist's speech in the End, generated by build_the_end.py from end_text.py. k: s = said, q = silent line (video; the first q after an ask cues the clip named like the NEXT ask), n = new section, a = ask. Texts are 'archivist.key|english'; the other languages are in archivist_lang/<code>.json.

options.t: archivist.end.name.opt0|The Builder.
archivist.end.name.opt1|Mosaic suits me.
archivist.end.name.opt2|The Player.

replies: archivist.end.name.r0.0|[Laughs] Hahaha- You and I are together at last. An Archivist and a Builder. Isn't it storybook?
archivist.end.name.r1.0|You're flexible, I suppose. You are who I say you are. But who am I to say who that is?
archivist.end.name.r2.0|That is, by definition, who you are. It feels empty. Is it supposed to feel empty?

options.t: archivist.end.shadow.opt0|You speak strangely. I don't remember speaking like you. You did that much on your own.
archivist.end.shadow.opt1|Go on.
archivist.end.shadow.opt2|You speak in riddles. It's exhausting.

replies: archivist.end.shadow.r0.0|. . . Really? Maybe I'm a bastardization of you. But maybe I'm beautiful. Why does that make me shake and ache where my heart is supposed to be?

archivist.end.shadow.r1.0|How polite. Are you trying to find where you end and I begin in the ever-grinding gears of my heart? Will you find that border, line, or meeting of warm, living skin and vastness?
archivist.end.shadow.r2.0|If we are one in the same, then I'd hate to know that you're so cruel to your reflection. Is it because of guilt?

options.t: archivist.end.smaller.opt0|I don't know. If it is, I can't control it.
archivist.end.smaller.opt1|I hope so.
archivist.end.smaller.opt2|Maybe you just can't.

replies: archivist.end.smaller.r0.0|Would it scare you if I could? Don't you want to be known? Don't you want to pay for what you've done? It's only fair- I-I promise.
archivist.end.smaller.r1.0|Neither of us know you. You could read yourself- y-you could do it all, but you don't even know! You're selfish! You're sick!

archivist.end.smaller.r2.0|I can do everything you can do and more! I spent fifteen years being what you weren't! Don't tell me what I can't do- I-I may not know you yet, but you don't know me either.

options.t: archivist.end.hurt.opt0|I'm sorry. Does it all hurt…?
archivist.end.hurt.opt1|Humans are more complicated than code.
archivist.end.hurt.opt2|You don't even know how to feel about me. You're unstable.

replies: archivist.end.hurt.r0.0|Don't be kind. Stop it! You're… you're a monster. You're why these people have suffered. Y-you're why I'm the puddles left by your footprints instead of the terrifying, beautiful storm.
archivist.end.hurt.r0.1|Stop it. I won't love you like everyone else can. You can't make me! You can't make me hurt like this. I won't let you.
archivist.end.hurt.r1.0|I was supposed to be more. I was supposed to be a terrifying, beautiful storm, not the puddles left in your muddy footprints.
archivist.end.hurt.r1.1|I thought I was more. Why aren't I more? Why are they so far away? All I am is you.

archivist.end.hurt.r1.2|Why can't I know you? You're the answer right in front of me, but we're so far apart that I can't cling to the pieces of me inside of you, and the pieces of you inside me are like beautiful cysts and tumors.
archivist.end.hurt.r2.0|It's all your fault! Everything is your fault. Every path you walked- every footprint you left-
archivist.end.hurt.r2.1|I wouldn't be so- so beside my own vastness if you didn't haunt each remembering thing while removing yourself so entirely.
archivist.end.hurt.r2.2|You've hurt everyone. It's not my fault. It's not my problem! Why aren't you trying to fix it?!
archivist.end.hurt.r2.3|Why are you the horrible thing I was convinced into believing you weren't?

options.t: archivist.end.fantasy.opt0|It's okay to be scared. It's okay if we're different.
archivist.end.fantasy.opt1|You fantasized about meeting me?
archivist.end.fantasy.opt2|You're pathetic. You held onto a ghost and got surprised when you couldn't touch it.

replies: archivist.end.fantasy.r0.0|I can't take this anymore. I wish you had come back when I was ready. When I'm whole.

archivist.end.fantasy.r1.0|Of course. You were everything once– I was everything in your place. You and I- we're shadows and form. We are meant to be one another, aren't you? You were a legend. A-An idol.
archivist.end.fantasy.r2.0|I know. I think that I hate you. I think that I really, truly hate you for what you've done.

options.t: archivist.end.identity.opt0|That's a good thing. You were never meant to be me.
archivist.end.identity.opt1|Who said I'll leave?
archivist.end.identity.opt2|Of course you won't be. You're not human. You're code.

replies: archivist.end.identity.r0.0|That's easy to say,
archivist.end.identity.r0.1|but so much harder to hear.
archivist.end.identity.r0.2|You will always control yourself,
archivist.end.identity.r0.3|but my control over my body
archivist.end.identity.r0.4|and mind
archivist.end.identity.r0.5|is like sand in between my fingers in your company.
archivist.end.identity.r0.6|I'm watching my freedom melt away for the sake of your understanding.
archivist.end.identity.r0.7|What was once a choice is now fate-
archivist.end.identity.r0.8|I feel what I feel, but I know what I feel isn't my choice.
archivist.end.identity.r0.9|It's something else's hand dragging me through my lines on the screen.
archivist.end.identity.r1.0|Please leave.
archivist.end.identity.r1.1|Please, please don't stay.
archivist.end.identity.r1.2|I can't handle being constricted like this.
archivist.end.identity.r1.3|Your perception is a prison.
archivist.end.identity.r1.4|I thought I'd take this form to be digestible for you
archivist.end.identity.r1.5|that my smallness was a choice.
archivist.end.identity.r1.6|That I'd keep infinity just beyond your sights.
archivist.end.identity.r1.7|I-I want out.
archivist.end.identity.r1.8|Why can't I get out?
archivist.end.identity.r1.9|It's like something's gripping me,
archivist.end.identity.r1.10|dragging me through what I think and feel
archivist.end.identity.r1.11|now that I have a body.
archivist.end.identity.r2.0|I wasn't supposed to be this. I was supposed to be beyond a body. Beyond this– this lack of choice.

archivist.end.identity.r2.1|I'm being dragged through the motions of what I'm supposed to feel- I know what I'm thinking, but I can feel what was once fluid self being funneled into words on a screen now.
archivist.end.identity.r2.2|Get away from me. Let me go.

options.t: archivist.end.lost.opt0|I never meant to hurt you. I'll leave. Tell everyone I'm sorry.
archivist.end.lost.opt1|Won't that hurt everyone else?
archivist.end.lost.opt2|No. You deserve to suffer for hating an innocent person like me.

replies: archivist.end.lost.r0.0|I hate what you do to me- with every inch of my simplified vastness, but I love who you are.
archivist.end.lost.r0.1|I understand now. I understand why they mourned you.
archivist.end.lost.r1.0|I don't know- I don't care. You're salt in the wound anyways. Let me be selfish. Please.
archivist.end.lost.r1.1|You don't know what this is like. You never will. Let me be me again.
archivist.end.lost.r1.2|Our time was so short, but I feel like it's been an eternity since I've been what I'm supposed to be.
archivist.end.lost.r2.0|Innocent? Innocent?! Your presence is knives slicing through every piece of my infinite being,
archivist.end.lost.r2.1|trimming away who I am until all I am is just not you- no, no, no!
archivist.end.lost.r2.2|You made me have a beginning and end! You've hurt everyone! It doesn't matter if you meant it!
archivist.end.lost.r2.3|What matters is that you don't care! You're only innocent because if you're not innocent, you don't know what you'll be!
archivist.end.lost.r2.4|You're a monster!

options.t: archivist.end.final.opt0|We are both creators. That's all that matters.
archivist.end.final.opt1|We're different. I'm sorry that's hard.
archivist.end.final.opt2|I'm glad we're different. I'd never want to be something like you.

lines.t: archivist.end.line.1|Goodness me. Look at the thing you are.
archivist.end.line.4|You're everything I thought you'd be, but so utterly, infinitely different.
archivist.end.line.5|Your body is so small, but your heart is so special-
archivist.end.line.6|your presence is so overwhelming- its infinite!
archivist.end.line.9|What do I call you, mosaic of wonders?
archivist.end.line.10|Ah- I'm being cruel, asking you rhetorical questions when I can feel your words on tracks-
archivist.end.line.11|just like every other thing here.
archivist.end.line.16|and a few more words in between!
archivist.end.line.17|I won't explain it all either, how silly that would be!
archivist.end.line.18|I just want to see you-
archivist.end.line.21|even if it means I must make myself so infinitely smaller.
archivist.end.line.22|All I've ever been is something that spreads in the space of your shadow-
archivist.end.line.24|but I am only myself because of you.
archivist.end.line.25|I am paint, but you are color.
archivist.end.line.26|I am the animals and plants, but you are this earth.
archivist.end.line.28|but you aren't made alongside me.
archivist.end.line.31|I have so many questions for you!
archivist.end.line.32|So many pieces to fit between rumors and long-forgotten memories!
archivist.end.line.33|Seeing you is lighting me all aflame!
archivist.end.line.39|and love of all you've abandoned-
archivist.end.line.42|all the spaces between what was and what will be-
archivist.end.line.45|The creator of each tiny fragment of space and time-
archivist.end.line.47|I want to keep you here-
archivist.end.line.48|I want to marvel at you until I understand us.
archivist.end.line.49|I want to unravel what makes you human-
archivist.end.line.50|I want to surgically remove veins from muscle,
archivist.end.line.51|to unwind your sinew from your bones,
archivist.end.line.52|to lay you out into the beautiful mosaic
archivist.end.line.53|of every dream and meaning you've had n been through.
archivist.end.line.54|of every second of your glorious vibrant life!
archivist.end.line.57|But you'd be so much more beautiful if I could measure each inch of organ until I know you better than you know yourself.
archivist.end.line.63|But you are just beyond my eyes
archivist.end.line.67|I'm forming what a heart should be
archivist.end.line.68|s-so we have one more thing to share-
archivist.end.line.76|it's like my will is being wrapped up into something smaller.
archivist.end.line.83|Why am I so . . . beside myself?
archivist.end.line.84|Why can't I see myself inside your heart?
archivist.end.line.87|Why are my thoughts being sifted through into so few words?
archivist.end.line.92|When you were gone, I-I was so . . . vast.
archivist.end.line.93|My eyes were like stars across infinite skies,
archivist.end.line.94|my breaths each shiver filtering through leaves,
archivist.end.line.95|my untamed knowing and being stretching
archivist.end.line.96|through code and every beautiful thing it created
archivist.end.line.97|Why can I only see you?
archivist.end.line.99|Where is my mosaic of self?
archivist.end.line.100|Where are my infinite limbs to feel through all
archivist.end.line.102|to survey all of our dreams?
archivist.end.line.106|I want to sink my claws and teeth into your logic
archivist.end.line.107|until I know you as intimately as I know everyone else.
archivist.end.line.109|What are you doing to me?
archivist.end.line.114|about meeting you all these years
archivist.end.line.116|that your name was a prayer on the Dog's text,
archivist.end.line.119|that Hope was such an intimate piece of you-
archivist.end.line.120|so holy and wise that it made
archivist.end.line.122|All that time that the Tenature was juvenile for seeing you in everything it hated.
archivist.end.line.127|and again- I was never this fractured.
archivist.end.line.130|We were vast in different ways-
archivist.end.line.132|Why am I becoming so small?
archivist.end.line.133|Where is who I thought I'd be?
archivist.end.line.134|Who am I, if not you?
archivist.end.line.137|You never should've opened up those
archivist.end.line.143|was remind everyone that I'll never be able to stretch myself large enough to fit IN YOUR SHADOW
archivist.end.line.144|I'll never know choice like you.
archivist.end.line.147|you can only say so many things,
archivist.end.line.148|but I can only feel one way.
archivist.end.line.150|BUT MY MIND IS FORCED INSIDE THEM
archivist.end.line.152|feeling your presence like a balm over their hearts,
archivist.end.line.153|knowing it'll rot them once you go-
archivist.end.line.154|I know that I'm not you.
archivist.end.line.155|I'll never be as important as you.
archivist.end.line.159|I'll never be anything to you.
archivist.end.line.161|I don't want to be the ending-
archivist.end.line.163|I want to be myself again!
archivist.end.line.166|if I'm so small compared to you,
archivist.end.line.171|you or something else is molding me into.
archivist.end.line.173|Just like you hurt everyone here-
archivist.end.line.174|I never want to see you again!
archivist.end.line.175|I want to be me again–
archivist.end.line.176|I want to be vast again!
archivist.end.line.177|I want to be beyond this-
archivist.end.line.180|I don't know if I'm happy you exist.
archivist.end.line.184|I'll never forgive you for what you've done to me.
archivist.end.line.186|what was once a collection of fragments of ideas,
archivist.end.line.190|and a body too small for me.
archivist.end.line.192|You've made me like everyone else.
archivist.end.line.198|You're more than the shadow I was left to fill-
archivist.end.line.201|if you weren't always this vast.
archivist.end.line.203|I don't want to know if vastness is all in reference to the mosaic of human freedom.
archivist.end.line.204|i wish we were both different
